title: Opt-in ads cover streamed text
summary:
Opt-in affiliate links now work across regular and streamed text responses, with the default still set to no referral links.

Chat completions gained opt-in affiliate-link processing for both regular and streamed responses. The `p-ads` marker enables contextual selection using generated text and recent messages; streamed responses can append a link at the end. Without the marker, the default referral-link probability remains zero.
